definitions.catch: capture-window distance under 50 mm; either ball counts for the two-ball robots
definitions.indicated: the ball the oracle flag names; the ceiling sees only that ball
definitions.between_miss: among misses, the hand at its closest approach was nearer the midpoint of the two balls than either ball
definitions.switches: times the base crossed from being closer to one planned intercept to the other, sampled at the policy rate
definitions.commitment_s: time of the last such crossing; 0 if the base never changed its nearer intercept

reading.label: averaging
reading.text: The oracle is near the ceiling and the squared-error copier is well below it, with many misses between the balls. The averaging failure is real.
